channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Open-Sources Dogwood, Extending Cedar to Govern Sequences of Agent Tool Calls
item.description: AWS has open-sourced Dogwood, a policy language extending Cedar with temporal conditions so rules can reason about an agent's prior tool calls rather than one request in isolation. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Clean Rooms supports exporting privacy-enhanced analysis logs for SQL
item.description: AWS Clean Rooms now supports exporting privacy-enhanced analysis logs for SQL analyses , offering customers greater optimization and troubleshooting capabilities. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick now supports approval policies for sharing
item.description: Amazon Quick now offers approval policies, giving administrators governance controls over how assets are shared within their organization. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick now supports per-user resource limits
item.description: Amazon Quick now enables administrators to set per-user limits on index storage and agent hours, giving them direct control over subscription costs. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick agentic AI capabilities are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
item.description: Today, AWS announces that Amazon Quick's agentic AI capabilities are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), bringing an agentic AI teammate to government and regulated-industry teams within an isolated, FedRAMP Class D (formerly High)… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
item.description: We are excited to announce the general availability of Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings, a state-of-the-art embedding model for agentic RAG and semantic search, in AWS GovCloud (US-West). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer launches performance dashboard for Cases
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now provides a performance dashboard for cases that helps managers monitor case volume, resolution trends, and performance against service level agreement (SLA) targets. (1 source: aws)
